[[Chainmail of Many Pockets]] }} == Objectives == Recover ‘Compendium of Successful Trade’ within Stormwrought Castle for Noppsy Spickerspan at the SI:7 Outpost on Balor. * [[Compendium of Successful Trade]] == Description == If you’re entering Stormwrought Castle, I have one humble request for you. The Balor family amassed countless books and tomes over the many years they held authority over the island. Following decades of trade, they collected a sheer unimaginable amount of knowledge in their library. One of them, the personal teachings and lectures on the hidden practices of trade by Sir Walton Balor, younger brother of the second Duke of Balor, is a book both I and Stormwind are very much interested in. Should you come across the vast library of Stormwrought Castle, search it for said book. And : Beware of the dangers inside. I dare not think about the terrors that await you within those vile halls. ==Rewards== You may choose one of: * [[Antiquated Slasher]] * [[Chainmail of Many Pockets]] You will also receive: * 3200 XP == Progress == Stormwind always envied the Balorians on perfecting the art of successful trade not only with them, but several other nations as well. It’d be a shame if that knowledge would be lost in time, no? == Completion == Oh, more dusty than my grandmother back in Ironforge. Time has not been kind to this old tome, and the humid air is not exactly helping either. I will seal it properly in my chest and begin analysis back in the SI:7 headquarters. For you, , my heartfelt gratitude. Please choose a reward fitting for your service. ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}}
